verdict.rationale: LobeHub publishes a public changelog of feature changes and documents Docker Compose self-hosting. The only migration doc is 'Migrate from Local Database', which covers moving data rather than upgrading between versions. Nothing in the pack shows these changelog entries are tied to versioned self-host releases, and no upgrade procedure is documented. missing for 10: version-numbered self-host release notes, per-version upgrade/migration notes, a documented update procedure for Docker deployments, a rollback or repair path when an update breaks, and independent corroboration that updates are safe.
